title: 第一章瘟祸弥世 四神降凡第二章虎牢遇险 初战妖邪
content_zh:
大唐太宗贞观四年，岁在庚寅，本该是四海承平、万象更新之岁。
自太宗皇帝登基以来，轻徭薄赋，励精图治，革除隋末乱世之积弊，天下百姓渐得喘息。此前数年，大唐铁骑北破突厥，威震边陲，中原大地本该迎来五谷丰登、安居乐业的盛景，长安城内，也曾一度是商贾云集，炊烟连绵，一派贞观初年的祥和气象。
可天有不测风云，一场无妄之灾，自暮春时节起，悄然席卷了大唐万里河山。
起初，只是江南水乡的几个村落，偶有百姓染病，起初只是身热乏力，不过三五日，便会浑身溃烂，咳喘不止，药石罔效，短短旬日，便会撒手人寰。当地郎中束手无策，州县官员急报朝廷，本以为只是小范围的时疫，未曾想，不过月余，瘟疫如同无形的恶鬼，顺着官道、河流，疯狂蔓延，自江南至中原，从关东到关中，乃至长安近郊，尽数被瘟疫笼罩。
一时间，大唐万里疆土，沦为人间炼狱。
瘟疫来势汹汹，不分老幼贵贱，但凡沾染，十死无生。田间地头，本该春耕的良田荒芜一片，不见农人劳作，唯有枯黄的禾苗在风中摇曳；村落之中，往日鸡鸣犬吠之声断绝，家家户户门窗紧闭，却依旧挡不住瘟神肆虐，时常有一户人家，一夜之间尽数染病，再无生息。街道之上，鲜有行人往来，偶尔有步履蹒跚的百姓，面色蜡黄，咳血不止，倒在路旁，无人敢上前施救，人人自危，惶惶不可终日。
各州各县的医馆，早已被挤得水泄不通，名贵药材消耗殆尽，郎中们穷尽毕生所学，开出的药方却如同石沉大海，丝毫不能遏制病情。棺木店铺的板材早早售空，寻常百姓家，只能用破旧的草席裹着逝者的遗体，草草掩埋，乱葬岗上，新坟叠旧坟，哀嚎之声、哭泣之声，昼夜不绝，直冲云霄。
就连繁华的长安都城，也褪去了往日的荣光。朱雀大街上，车马稀少，行人步履匆匆，人人用布巾掩住口鼻，神色惶恐。皇宫之内，太宗皇帝李世民眉头紧锁，连日召集文武百官，商议抗疫之策，国库拨出无数钱粮，派遣太医遍访疫区，可瘟疫依旧愈演愈烈，毫无消退之兆。
御书房内，烛火摇曳，太宗身着龙袍，面容憔悴，看着桌案上堆积如山的疫区急报，长叹一声：“朕登基四年，一心为民，未曾敢有丝毫懈怠，为何苍天要降下如此大祸，让我大唐百姓深陷水火，苦不堪言！”
一旁的房玄龄、魏征等重臣，亦是面色凝重，无言以对。他们穷尽智谋，能安天下，能定边陲，却对这天降瘟疫，毫无办法。
“陛下，”魏征上前一步，声音低沉，“此瘟疫非比寻常，不似人间寻常疫病，太医署研判，此乃戾气凝聚而成的瘟灾，寻常药物根本无法化解，恐怕……乃是天道异动，天降劫难啊。”
太宗闻言，心中一沉，抬头望向窗外漆黑的夜空，繁星点点，却透着一股说不出的萧瑟。他自幼熟读经史，深知天地异象，必有缘由，只是如今苍生受难，他身为人间帝王，却只能眼睁睁看着百姓殒命，心中愧疚万分。
而在九天之上，凌霄宝殿，云雾缭绕，瑞气千条，众神齐聚，静听玉帝法旨。
三界之内，自有天道轮回，人间瘟疫肆虐，戾气冲天，早已惊动了三界诸神。玉帝端坐凌霄宝殿龙椅之上，面色肃穆，俯瞰三界，眼中满是悲悯。
“人间大唐，瘟祸横行，苍生涂炭，此乃天地戾气失衡，阴阳颠倒所致，”玉帝的声音威严浩荡，响彻整个凌霄宝殿，“昔日混沌初开，天地间有一创世玉盘，蕴含天地灵气，阴阳调和之力，可净化世间一切邪祟戾气，化解瘟祸，安定乾坤。此玉盘流落西天灵山深处，被万妖盘踞，历经千年，无人可取。”
众神闻言，纷纷低头，心中了然。那创世玉盘，乃是上古神器，拥有扭转乾坤、净化天地的无上神力，只是西天之路，艰险万分，妖魔鬼怪层出不穷，更有重重劫难阻拦，寻常神仙，根本无法靠近。
玉帝目光扫过众神，最终定格在天庭四方，镇守东西南北四极的四位正神身上。
东方青龙神君，名曰宁洋北，镇守东方天界，主木气，掌生机，身携九天青木灵气，心怀慈悲，心怀苍生，性情温润，却又有坚守正道的刚毅，乃是东方天地灵气所化，执掌东方星辰运转，护佑天下草木生灵。
西方白虎神君，名曰陈学西，镇守西方天界，主金气，掌杀伐，一身正气凛然，武艺通天，性情刚正不阿，嫉恶如仇，手中白虎战刃，可斩尽世间妖邪，乃是西方杀伐正气所聚，镇守天界西方门户，震慑万千妖魔。
南方朱雀神君，名曰张忠东，镇守南方天界，主火气，掌光明，身带涅槃圣火，可净化邪祟，性情热忱，心怀大义，做事果敢，能以圣火驱散黑暗，化解戾气，乃是南方光明之火所化，护佑人间光明。

北方玄武神君，名曰王学南，镇守北方天界，主水气，掌智慧，沉稳内敛，心思缜密，通晓天地阴阳之理，深谙奇门遁甲、疗伤续命之术，性情敦厚，行事稳重，乃是北方灵水所化，守护天地阴阳平衡。
四方四神，各司其职，镇守天界四极，维系天地秩序，修为通天，心怀正道，乃是天庭最是忠勇可靠的四位正神。
“宁洋北、陈学西、张忠东、王学南，”玉帝沉声开口，声音传遍四方，“朕今法旨，命你四人，卸下天界神职，褪去仙骨，入人间历劫，转世为凡身，前往西天，寻回创世玉盘。此去西天，路途千万里，需历经七十二难，一路斩妖除魔，化解重重险阻，不得动用天界仙法，需以凡身之躯，历经磨难，方可得天道认可，取回玉盘，拯救人间苍生于水火。”
四方四神闻言，齐齐上前一步，躬身行礼，神色庄重。
“臣，遵玉帝法旨！”
四人异口同声，声音铿锵，响彻凌霄宝殿。
他们身为天界正神，目睹人间百姓受难，心中早已悲悯万分，如今领受玉帝法旨，前往西天寻玉盘救世，纵然前路艰险，历经万般劫难，也绝无半分退缩。
“此去西行，非比寻常，”玉帝神色愈发凝重，叮嘱道，“你四人下凡之后，仙法封印，记忆暂封，唯有历经尘世磨难，方能逐步唤醒神识，找回神力。需同心协力，不离不弃，方能闯过重重劫难。若能成功取回玉盘，便是救三界苍生，功德无量，届时重回天界，加官进爵，万古流芳；若半途而废，或是心生邪念，便会永留凡尘，魂飞魄散，永无归期。”
“臣等谨记玉帝教诲，誓死完成使命，绝不辜负天庭重托，绝不辜负天下苍生！”宁洋北率先开口，语气坚定，其余三神亦是纷纷附和，眼神中满是决绝。
玉帝微微颔首，抬手一挥，一道金光自玉帝指尖涌出，化作四道神光，分别笼罩在四方四神身上。
刹那间，四神只觉得浑身仙力被缓缓封印，天界神识被暂时封存，身形渐渐变得轻盈，一股强大的力量裹挟着他们，朝着九天之下的人间大唐，飞速坠落。
金光划过天际，如同四颗流星，划破长安夜空，朝着长安城四方，悄然降落。
此时的长安城外，西郊一处破庙之中，一个衣衫单薄的少年，在寒风中悠悠转醒。
少年约莫十六七岁年纪，面容清俊，眼神澄澈，只是面色有些苍白，身上穿着破旧的粗布衣衫，醒来之后，眼中满是茫然，环顾四周，只见破庙破败不堪，蛛网密布，寒风从破窗灌入，冷意刺骨。
他忘了自己是谁，忘了自己来自何处，脑海中一片空白，只记得一个名字——宁洋北。
他只觉得心中有一股莫名的使命感，隐隐觉得，自己要做一件大事，要去一个很远的地方，拯救很多受苦的人。可具体要做什么，要去哪里，他却毫无头绪，只觉得心头沉甸甸的，满是对世间苦难的悲悯。
宁洋北挣扎着站起身，走出破庙，看着远处长安城内灰蒙蒙的天空，听着隐约传来的百姓哭泣之声，心中一阵酸楚。他走到田间，看着荒芜的良田，看着路旁倒毙的流民，眼中满是不忍，下意识地想要伸手去帮扶，却发现自己只是一介凡身，手无缚鸡之力，根本无能为力。
与此同时，长安城南，一处贫民窟内，一个身材魁梧、面容刚毅的少年，猛地从地上坐起。
他眼神锐利，如同出鞘的利刃，浑身透着一股凛然正气，醒来之后，同样记忆残缺，只记得自己名叫张忠东。
他站起身，看着周围染病卧床的百姓，看着孩童们饥饿啼哭、大人奄奄一息的惨状，心中怒火中烧，一股杀伐之气油然而生。他攥紧拳头，指节发白，心中只有一个念头：要铲除这世间的邪祟，要结束这人间的苦难，要找到办法，拯救这些受苦的百姓。

他自幼便力气过人，性情果敢，看着身边的人一个个被瘟疫夺走性命，他再也无法坐视不管，起身朝着长安城外走去，想要寻找化解瘟疫的方法。
长安城北，一条小河边，一个面容敦厚、眼神沉稳的少年，缓缓睁开双眼。
他心思缜密，神情平静，仿佛世间万事，都无法扰乱他的心神，醒来之后，唯一清晰的记忆，便是自己的名字——王学南。
他坐在河边，看着河水潺潺，脑海中莫名浮现出许多阴阳调和、疗伤治病的法门，虽然不甚清晰，却能隐约感知到，这瘟疫乃是邪祟戾气所致。他看着河中倒映的自己，又看着远处疫区的方向，心中暗自思忖，要寻找到化解戾气的方法，要找到同伴，一同救世。
content_en:
Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty lived in Gengyin for the fourth year of Zhenguan. It should have been the year when the world was at peace and everything was renewed.
Since Emperor Taizong ascended the throne, he has been light on corvees and low on taxes, and has worked hard to eradicate the long-standing disadvantages of the troubled times in the late Sui Dynasty, and the people of the world have gradually gained some respite. In the past few years, the Tang Dynasty cavalry defeated the Turks in the north and shocked the border areas. The Central Plains should have ushered in a prosperous period of abundant harvests and peace and contentment. The city of Chang'an was once full of merchants and smoke, giving it a peaceful atmosphere like the early years of Zhenguan.
But something unexpected happened, and an unforeseen disaster quietly swept through the mountains and rivers of the Tang Dynasty starting from late spring.
At first, it was only a few villages in the Jiangnan water town. People occasionally fell ill. At first, they only suffered from fever and fatigue. Within three to five days, the whole body would be full of ulcers, coughing and wheezing, and the medicine would not work. In just ten days, he would pass away. The local doctors were helpless, and state and county officials rushed to report to the court. They thought it was just a small-scale epidemic, but they never thought. Within a month, the plague was like an invisible evil ghost, spreading crazily along official roads and rivers. From the south of the Yangtze River to the Central Plains, from Guandong to Guanzhong, and even the suburbs of Chang'an, everyone was enveloped by the plague.
For a time, the vast territory of the Tang Dynasty was reduced to a human hell.
The plague is coming in a ferocious manner, regardless of age, age or status. Anyone who is infected will die. In the fields, the fertile fields that were supposed to be plowed in the spring were deserted. There were no farmers working, and only the yellow seedlings were swaying in the wind. In the villages, the crowing of chickens and the barking of dogs in the past were cut off, and the doors and windows of every house were closed, but they still could not stop the plague from raging. There was often a family that was all infected with the disease overnight and no longer survived. On the streets, there were few pedestrians coming and going. Occasionally, some staggering people, with sallow complexions and coughing up blood, fell on the roadside. No one dared to come forward to rescue them. Everyone was in danger and was in panic all day long.
Medical clinics in various states and counties have long been overcrowded, and the precious medicinal materials have been exhausted. Doctors have exhausted all their lifelong learning, but the prescriptions they prescribe are like nothing, and they can't curb the disease at all. The coffin shops have sold out the boards early, and ordinary people can only wrap the deceased's body in shabby straw mats and bury it hastily. On the mass graves, new graves are piled on top of old graves, and the sounds of wailing and crying continue day and night, reaching into the sky.
Even the prosperous capital city of Chang'an has faded from its former glory. On Zhuque Street, there were few cars and horses, and pedestrians walked in a hurry. Everyone covered their mouths and noses with cloth towels, looking terrified. In the palace, Emperor Taizong Li Shimin frowned and summoned civil and military officials for days to discuss anti-epidemic strategies. The treasury allocated countless money and food and sent imperial doctors to visit the affected areas, but the plague continued to intensify and showed no sign of abating.
In the imperial study room, candlelight flickered. Taizong was dressed in a dragon robe with a haggard face. He looked at the piles of emergency reports from the epidemic areas on his desk and sighed: "I have been on the throne for four years and have devoted myself to serving the people. I have never dared to slack off. Why would the sky bring such a disaster and make the people of the Tang Dynasty plunge into misery and misery?"
Fang Xuanling, Wei Zheng and other important ministers on the side also looked solemn and speechless. They have exhausted all their wisdom and wisdom, and they can pacify the world and control the borders, but they have no way to deal with the plague that comes from the sky.
"Your Majesty," Wei Zheng took a step forward with a low voice, "This plague is extraordinary. It is not like ordinary diseases in the world. The Imperial Medical Office has determined that this is a plague caused by the condensation of violent energy. Ordinary medicines cannot resolve it. I am afraid... it is a sudden change in the way of heaven and a disaster from heaven."
When Taizong heard this, his heart sank. He looked up at the dark night sky outside the window. There were many stars, but there was an indescribable desolation. He has been familiar with scriptures and history since he was a child, and he knows that there must be a reason for the visions in the world. However, now that the people are suffering, as a human emperor, he can only watch the people die, feeling extremely guilty in his heart.
And above the nine heavens, in the Lingxiao Palace, there are clouds and mist, thousands of auspicious auras, and all the gods gather to listen to the Jade Emperor's decree.
Within the Three Realms, there is reincarnation of heaven, plagues are raging in the world, and the violence is soaring, which has already alarmed the gods of the Three Realms. The Jade Emperor is sitting on the dragon chair in the Lingxiao Palace, with a solemn look on his face.Looking down at the three realms, my eyes are full of compassion.
"In the Tang Dynasty, plagues were rampant and the people were devastated. This was caused by the imbalance of the violent energy of heaven and earth and the reversal of yin and yang." The Jade Emperor's voice was majestic and powerful, resounding throughout the Lingxiao Palace. "In the past, chaos first opened, and there was a creation between heaven and earth. The jade plate contains the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and the power of yin and yang harmony, which can purify all evil spirits in the world, resolve plagues, and stabilize the world. This jade plate has been wandering deep in the West Tianling Mountain and has been occupied by thousands of monsters. After thousands of years, no one can take it away. "
Hearing this, the gods bowed their heads one after another, understanding in their hearts. The creation jade plate is an ancient artifact, possessing the supreme power to turn things around and purify the world. However, the road to the west is extremely difficult and dangerous, with demons and monsters emerging in endlessly, and many disasters blocking it. Ordinary gods cannot approach it at all.
The Jade Emperor's eyes swept across the gods, and finally settled on the four righteous gods guarding the four poles of the heaven, east, west, south, and north.
The Eastern Green Dragon Divine Lord, named Ning Yangbei, guards the eastern heaven, controls the wood energy, and controls the vitality. He carries the Nine Heavens Green Wood Spirit Energy, has a compassionate heart, cares about the common people, has a gentle temperament, but also has the fortitude to stick to the right path.
The White Tiger Divine Lord of the West, named Chen Xuexi, guards the Western Heaven. He controls the golden energy and controls the killing. He is full of righteousness, has great martial arts, has an upright temperament, and hates evil as much as hatred. The white tiger sword in his hand can kill all the evil spirits in the world. It is the gathering of Western Killing righteousness, guarding the western portal of the Heaven, and deterring thousands of monsters.
The Southern Suzaku Divine Lord, named Zhang Zhongdong, guards the southern heaven. He controls fire and light. He carries the holy fire of Nirvana, which can purify evil spirits. He is enthusiastic in temperament, has a righteous heart, and is bold in doing things. He can use the holy fire to dispel darkness and resolve hostility. He is transformed by the light fire of the south and protects the light in the world.
The Northern Xuanwu Divine Lord, named Wang Xuenan, guards the northern heaven. He governs water and energy, controls wisdom, is calm and restrained, has a thoughtful mind, understands the principles of yin and yang in the world, and is well versed in the art of Qimen Dunjia, healing wounds and prolonging life. He has a kind-hearted temperament and is prudent in his actions. He is transformed from the spiritual water of the north and protects the balance of yin and yang in the world.
The four gods in the four directions, each performing their own duties, guarding the four poles of the heaven, maintaining the order of heaven and earth, cultivating to reach the heavens, and having the right path in mind, are the four most loyal, brave and reliable gods in heaven.
"Ning Yangbei, Chen Xuexi, Zhang Zhongdong, and Wang Xuenan," the Jade Emperor said in a deep voice, and his voice spread in all directions, "I now decree that you four will step down from your celestial duties, shed your immortal bones, enter the human world, undergo tribulations, reincarnate as a mortal body, and go to the West to find the Jade Plate of Creation. "The journey to the West is thousands of miles long, and we have to go through seventy-two difficulties, slay demons, and resolve many obstacles along the way. We are not allowed to use the magic of the heavens. We need to go through hardships in our mortal bodies before we can get the approval of heaven, retrieve the jade plate, and save the world from water and fire."
Upon hearing this, the four gods from all directions stepped forward and bowed with solemn expressions.
"My lord, obey the Jade Emperor's decree!"
The four people spoke in unison, and their voices were sonorous, resounding throughout the Lingxiao Palace.
As the righteous gods of the heaven, they have witnessed the suffering of the people in the world, and their hearts have long been filled with compassion. Now they accept the Jade Emperor's decree and go to the West to find the jade plate to save the world. Even though the road ahead is difficult and dangerous and they have experienced all kinds of disasters, they will never flinch.
"This trip to the west is unusual," the Jade Emperor's expression became more solemn as he warned, "After the four of you descended to earth, your immortal magic was sealed and your memories were temporarily sealed. Only by going through the hardships in the world can you gradually awaken your spiritual consciousness and regain your divine power. You need to work together and never give up. Only then can we overcome many catastrophes. If we can successfully retrieve the jade plate, we will save the people of the three realms, and our merits will be immeasurable. At that time, we will return to the heaven, be promoted to a noble position, and be famous forever. If we give up halfway, or have evil thoughts, we will remain in the mortal world forever, and our soul will be scattered, never to return. "
"I will remember the Jade Emperor's teachings and swear to complete my mission to the death. I will never let down the trust of heaven and the people of the world!" Ning Yangbei was the first to speak, with a firm tone. The other three gods also agreed, with determination in their eyes.The Jade Emperor nodded slightly, raised his hand, and a golden light emerged from the Jade Emperor's fingertips, turning into four rays of divine light and covering the four gods in all directions.
In an instant, the four gods felt that their immortal power was slowly being sealed, their heavenly consciousness was temporarily sealed, their bodies gradually became lighter, and a powerful force enveloped them, and they fell rapidly towards the human Tang Dynasty under the nine heavens.
Golden light streaked across the sky, like four shooting stars, piercing the night sky of Chang'an, landing quietly towards all directions of Chang'an City.
At this time, outside Chang'an City, in a ruined temple in the western suburbs, a young man in thin clothes slowly woke up in the cold wind.
The young man was about sixteen or seventeen years old, with a handsome face and clear eyes, but his face was a little pale. He was wearing shabby coarse clothes. After waking up, his eyes were full of confusion. Looking around, he saw a dilapidated temple with dense cobwebs. The cold wind poured in through the broken windows, which was biting.
He forgot who he was and where he came from. His mind went blank except for one name - Ning Yangbei.
He just felt an inexplicable sense of mission in his heart. He vaguely felt that he had to do something big and go to a far away place to save many suffering people. But he had no clue what he wanted to do or where he wanted to go. He only felt that his heart was heavy, full of compassion for the suffering in the world.
Ning Yangbei struggled to stand up, walked out of the ruined temple, looked at the gray sky in Chang'an City in the distance, and listened to the faint sound of people crying, feeling sad in his heart. He walked to the field, looked at the barren fertile fields, and looked at the homeless people lying dead on the roadside. His eyes were full of unbearability, and he subconsciously wanted to reach out to help, but he found that he was just a mortal, with no power to tie a chicken, and there was nothing he could do.
At the same time, in a slum in the south of Chang'an City, a burly young man with a resolute face suddenly sat up from the ground.
His eyes were sharp, like a sharp blade being drawn out of its sheath, and he exuded a sense of awe and righteousness. After he woke up, his memory was also incomplete, and he only remembered that his name was Zhang Zhongdong.
He stood up and looked at the sick and bedridden people around him. He looked at the miserable situation of children crying from hunger and adults dying. He was filled with anger and a murderous aura arose spontaneously in his heart. He clenched his fists, his knuckles turned white, and he had only one thought in his mind: to eradicate the evil spirits in the world, to end the suffering in the world, and to find a way to save these suffering people.
He has been extremely strong and courageous since he was a child. Seeing the people around him being killed by the plague one by one, he could no longer sit idly by and walked towards the outside of Chang'an City, trying to find a way to resolve the plague.
In the north of Chang'an City, by a small river, a young man with an honest face and steady eyes slowly opened his eyes.
He was thoughtful and calm, as if nothing in the world could disturb his mind. After waking up, the only clear memory was his name - Wang Xuenan.
He sat by the river, watching the gurgling water, and inexplicably many methods of harmonizing yin and yang, healing wounds and diseases emerged in his mind. Although it was not clear, he could vaguely sense that the plague was caused by evil spirits. He looked at himself reflected in the river, and then looked at the direction of the epidemic area in the distance, thinking secretly in his heart that he needed to find a way to resolve the hostility, find companions, and save the world together.
